source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

items.name: Infiltration Tools
items.text: A dig-widget's face consists of a set of Infiltrator Thieves' Tools. They can be salvaged from a destroyed dig-widget with a successful DC 20 Crafting check check. On a failed check, the tools are destroyed.

items.name: Mechanical Vulnerability
items.text: A creature with expert proficiency in Thievery can attempt a check to disable-device dc=20 to damage a dig-widget. The DC is 20, and each success deals 18 untyped damage.

items.name: Fastening Leap
items.text: The dig-widget Leaps up 20 feet onto a creature or object and attempts a corkscrew Strike against it. If the Strike damages the target, the dig-widget attaches to the target (typically to the back of a creature). This is similar to Grabbing the creature, but the dig-widget moves with that creature rather than holding it in place. While attached, the dig-widget can't use its corkscrew. The dig-widget can be Shoved off, or it can detach itself with an Interact action.

items.name: Grind Bones
items.text:
Requirements A grinder-widget adjacent to the millstone in area C41 has a creature Grabbed

---
Effect The grinder-widget attaches pliers to one of the millstone's handles and Strides around it, causing the Grabbed character to be painfully ground and pulped by the stone. The ground character must attempt a DC 23 Reflex save save with the following results.

---
Critical Success The character is unaffected and automatically Escapes from the grapple.

Success The character takes 1d8+2 bludgeoning damage and then automatically Escapes from the grapple.

Failure The character takes 2d8+2 bludgeoning damage and becomes Clumsy 1 for 1 hour from wrenched and sprained limbs; the character remains grappled by the grinder-widget.

Critical Failure As failure, but 4d8+2 bludgeoning damage and clumsy 1 for 24 hours.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.text: A dig-widget's Strikes deal an additional 1d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.
